URL: https://inews.co.uk/news/burnham-allies-2-cap-bus-fares-4656009
NOTE: i Paper (20 Jul) context — £2 single-fare limit introduced by Conservatives Jan 2023, raised to £3 by Labour from Jan 2025 (autumn 2024 Budget). Burnham kept £2 across Greater Manchester Bee Network as mayor. Transport Sec Heidi Alexander backed return; previously funded free bus travel for children 5-15 in England during August. Cap applies to ~5,000 routes.
